chunks: Ibn Bukayr narrated from Zurārah, who said:

I said to Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام: 'What is the sunnah (prophetic tradition) regarding fasting?' He said: 'Three days from every month: Thursday in the first ten days, Wednesday in the middle ten days, and Thursday in the last ten days.'
He said: I said, 'Is this all of what the sunnah (prophetic tradition) has established in fasting?' He said: 'Yes.'

key_terms.شَهْرٍ: the month in which these fasts recur regularly
key_terms.ٱلسُّنَّةُ: the established prophetic tradition and prescribed practice
key_terms.ٱلصَّوْمِ: fasting as an act of worship
key_terms.ٱلْأَرْبِعَاءِ: Wednesday, the designated fasting day in the middle third
key_terms.ٱلْخَمِيسِ: Thursday, the designated fasting day in two thirds of the month

ai.seo_question: What is the sunnah (prophetic tradition) method of fasting three recommended days each month?
ai.summary: This hadith states the recommended sunnah (prophetic tradition) fasts of each month as three days distributed across its three ten-day periods. It presents a practical legal guideline in devotional worship and identifies this pattern as the established sunnah (prophetic tradition) in fasting.
